supersedes_reason: User correction: the previous Compact №3 result does not match the two selected mockups in the running Electron app; browser fixture captures and passing tests did not establish native visual acceptance.
goal: Make the running Workspace Electron Board and expanded project visually match the selected Compact №3 mockups on comparable isolated data and equal viewports, while preserving working product behavior, then deliver native full-resolution evidence and a verified local commit.
hypothesis: Identify the actual native build and measure its composition against the reference images, then correct renderer layout, typography, spacing and status presentation within existing behavior and service boundaries; paired native captures will show the material deviations removed.
scope: Workspace renderer UI, focused tests and UI handoff documents; isolated visual fixtures and native captures. No live user project changes, storage, IPC, Electron security, project identity, status rules, backend, push, merge or release.
measurement_plan: First identify the active native process, executable, working directory, loaded renderer URL and build provenance. Compare Board and expanded project with the reference images at 1486x1059, using comparable six-project data, status names/colors and open tabs; save before and after full-resolution native captures and a deviation map. Also inspect compact layout at 1440x960 and 1024x720. Assess material deviations by named regions and visible composition rather than inventing a pixel threshold. A thumbnail or browser-only screenshot cannot satisfy native visual outcome.

checks.description: Record the executable/process, branch/commit, build path/mtime or hash, and loaded native renderer for the app under test; unknown or mismatched provenance falsifies the check.

Relevant Node tests, npm run typecheck, npm run build:renderer and git diff --check pass; native tabs, project operations, property/settings actions and keyboard accessibility remain usable on isolated data, with no storage/IPC/security/identity/status-rule change. Any failed command or lost action falsifies.

Full-resolution native Electron Board and expanded captures at the same 1486x1059 viewport and comparable data as both selected mockups support a region-by-region deviation map: sidebar, toolbar, status accents, board columns/cards and expanded properties/file tree materially align, with each remaining significant mismatch specifically explained. Missing paired capture, browser substitution or unexplained material deviation falsifies.
Native compact layout at 1440x960 and 1024x720 keeps required actions, readable text, visible focus and accessible tab overflow; clipped action, unreadable content or second toolbar row falsifies.

A reviewable local commit contains intended changes and linked native captures, deviation map, check output, provenance, limitations and independent verifier report; absent artifacts, uncommitted product changes or misleading screenshot labels falsify.
